name: Mood Pop
summary: A React button that springs open six drawn faces, then flies your pick in and bursts into tiny copies
about: A book fair post with a React button. Opening it springs out a tray of six hand-drawn faces that pop up one by one, each with its own habit (pulsing heart eyes, giggles, spinning stars, a dripping tear), and swell like a dock under your pointer. Picking one puffs it up, flies it along an arc into the button and bursts a ring, a spray of tiny copies and sparkles while the face stack, names and the per-reaction breakdown update; picking it again takes the reaction back.
how: Press React (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space) to open the tray of faces.
Move across the faces with the pointer or the Left and Right arrow keys, then press one to react.
Open the tray again and pick another face to switch, or your current face to remove it; Escape closes the tray.
Press the reactions count to see the breakdown by type.
